datasets.name: operations-by-branch
datasets.sql: select b.branch_id as "branchId", b.branch_name as "branchName", count(*) filter (where w.status = 'open') as "openWork", min(w.created_at) filter (where w.status = 'open') as "oldestOpenAt", count(*) filter (where w.status = 'completed' and w.completed_at >= now() - interval '7 days') as "completedLast7Days", max(w.updated_at) as "sourceUpdatedAt" from source_operations.work_orders w join source_operations.branches b on b.branch_id = w.branch_id where w.status = 'open' or (w.status = 'completed' and w.completed_at >= now() - interval '7 days') group by b.branch_id, b.branch_name order by "openWork" desc, b.branch_id asc limit 100

datasets.name: open-work
datasets.sql: select w.work_order_id as "workOrderId", b.branch_id as "branchId", b.branch_name as "branchName", w.priority, w.created_at as "createdAt", w.updated_at as "sourceUpdatedAt" from source_operations.work_orders w join source_operations.branches b on b.branch_id = w.branch_id where w.status = 'open' order by w.created_at asc, w.work_order_id asc limit 250
